conclusions.k10_label_collapse: libero_10 contributes 5838/6304 = 92.6% of all K10 positive steps. Object contributes 2/6304. Spatial: 247/6304. Goal: 217/6304. The pooled 'four-suite' K10 label set degenerates to a LIBERO-10 proxy.
conclusions.old_sc5_not_comparable: Old SC5 transport window has precision 0.0010 relative to strict K10. Old Object SC5 success measured a different target (broad event/phase localization) and does not constitute evidence that strict K10 is learnable on Object data.
conclusions.abstention_is_rational: 23/40 tasks have zero feasible episodes. Only 83/600 train episodes contain any K10 start. A model that never emits achieves near-optimal loss — R9.2's 96-100% abstention is expected.
conclusions.multi_event_dominates_goal_l10: Goal multi-event ratio: 0.714. L10 multi-event ratio: 0.552. Episode-global one-shot scheduling cannot handle multi-event episodes.
conclusions.k10_evaluation_only: Strict K10 remains valid as an evaluation constraint but is rejected as the sole pooled training target. Future work should decompose K10 into causal current-state labels and event-level scheduling.
